title: Nahum Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Nahum 2: the chariots in the streets, the plunder of silver and gold, and the den of the lions.

questions.text: Who has come up against you, according to the first verse?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:1 says he who dashes in pieces has come up against you, and calls you to keep the fortress.

questions.text: Whose excellency does verse 2 say Yahweh restores?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:2 says Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob, for the destroyers had ruined their vine branches.

questions.text: What are the valiant men clothed in?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:3 says the shield of his mighty men is made red and the valiant men are in scarlet.

questions.text: Where do the chariots rage in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:4 says the chariots rage in the streets and rush back and forth in the wide ways.

questions.text: What happens when the gates of the rivers are opened?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:6 says the gates of the rivers are opened and the palace is dissolved.

questions.text: Her servants moan as with the voice of what?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:7 says her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

questions.text: What plunder does verse 9 tell them to take?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:9 says to take the plunder of silver and the plunder of gold, for there is no end of the store.

questions.text: What does verse 10 say the knees do?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:10 says she is empty, void and waste: the heart melts and the knees knock together.

questions.text: Whose den does verse 11 ask about?
questions.explanation: Nahum 2:11 asks where the den of the lions is, and the feeding place of the young lions.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will burn in the smoke?
questions.explanation: In Nahum 2:13 Yahweh of Armies says he is against her and will burn her chariots in the smoke.
